newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TRAVEL SERVICES HOLDINGS IN FUNDING FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TRAVEL SERVICES HOLDINGS IN FUNDING FACILITY.

text.p: China Travel Services Holdings Hong Kong Ltd's US$150 million five-year financing facility has been launched into general syndication via a special-purpose company, bankers said.
The first three years is a U.S. commercial paper programme combined with a revolving credit facility and the remaining two years will be a term loan facility.

Therefore, the first three years of the facility could be on an unfunded basis to the banks in the syndicate if commercial paper is issued or it could be on a funded basis if the revolving credit is drawn.
The facility guarantee fee is 62 basis points per annum if the facility is on an unfunded basis for the first three years.
If the revolving credit is drawn, the borrower will pay an interest margin of 95 basis points over London Interbank Offered Rate.
The two-year bullet loan pays an interest margin of 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.

Management fees are 25 basis points for lead managers committing US$10 million or more, 20 basis points for co-lead mangers committing US$6-9 million and 15 basis points for senior managers committing US$3-5 million.
The issuer is the parent company of China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd
Arrangers are Bankers Trust Hong Kong, Credit Agricole Indosuez, LTCB Hong Kong, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong, Sumitomo Bank Hong Kong, CS First Boston New York and Fuji Bank.
